title: Version components and numeric prerelease identifiers are compared as Number, so above 2^53 a stale entry can be taken for history
resolution: Version components and numeric prerelease identifiers compare as BigInt; regression tests cover a major, a minor, a stale patch entry, and prerelease identifiers above 2^53

title: Two entries for one path whose versions differ only in build metadata are rejected as a repeat, though path and version differ
resolution: Entries are unique by path and full version string and sort by path, precedence, then version text; the requirement and the scenario Build metadata state it, and a regression test covers it

title: The Matching entry scenario accepts the listed changes in any order, while the file validation rejects an entry whose changes are not sorted
resolution: The scenario Matching entry names a valid entry with sorted changes and found changes in any order, and a test reads the file and then compares

title: An unknown BASE revision ends make contract-breaking-changes with an unhandled git stack trace instead of a clear message
resolution: commitOf returns nothing for an unresolvable BASE and the listing reports it as not a commit with exit 1; a test runs the script with an unknown --base

title: No test covers how checkDocuments combines the compatibility and declaration problems or skips the declarations of a malformed file
resolution: The combination moves into the exported pure documentProblems, which a test covers with a matching entry, a missing entry, a stale entry next to the existing rule, and a malformed file

title: The requirement and the Malformed declarations scenario omit that unsorted or repeated breaking changes fail, which the code enforces
resolution: The Malformed declarations scenario names changes not sorted and unique; the requirement stays at 489 characters under the strict limit

title: The schema caps a reason at 500 characters, which neither design decision 3 nor the requirement mentions
resolution: Design decision 3 names the reason limit of 500 characters

title: The script header cites ADR 0004 item 6, while the ADR and the records call it principle 6
resolution: The script header cites ADR 0004 principle 6

title: The oasdiff row says only make contract-compatibility runs it, though make contract-breaking-changes runs it too
resolution: The oasdiff row names make contract-compatibility and make contract-breaking-changes

title: The author self-check gives the pre-fix 442 characters and its scenario table lacks Build metadata and the new Matching entry test
resolution: The author self-check gives the counts as of the pass 2 fixes and maps Build metadata and the file-reading Matching entry test
